_comment: Checksums of migrations that have shipped in a release.
An entry is immutable: editing the file it names breaks every database that
already recorded the old checksum, and those databases fail startup closed.
To change behaviour, add a new forward-only migration and record it here in
baseline_schema_fingerprint is the fingerprint of db/schema/ as released.
Installed databases never re-read db/schema/, so a baseline edit reaches them
only through a migration that makes the same change. Record the new
fingerprint in the commit that adds that migration.
released_baseline_fingerprints is append-only: every baseline a published release shipped, the supported upgrade sources of ADR 0054.
